result.stderr:
Usage:
  routster-module keygen <private.pem> <public.pem>
      a new P-256 key pair; keep the private key out of every repository
  routster-module pack <folder> <out.rsmod | out-folder> <key-id> <private.pem>
      packs and signs a module folder (manifest.json, lib/...); given a folder,
      names the package <id>-<version>.rsmod inside it
  routster-module verify <package.rsmod> <key-id> <public.pem>
      checks a package the way Studio will
  routster-module sign-manifest <manifest.json> <key-id> <private.pem>
      signs a release's update manifest, writing manifest.json.sig beside it
  routster-module index <packages-folder> [page-base-url]
      writes the module catalogue, index.json, from the signed packages in a folder
  routster-module sign-index <index.json> <key-id> <private.pem>
      signs the catalogue, writing index.json.sig beside it

For a module's author (developer mode: only your own Studio trusts your key):
  routster-module run <project-folder>
      builds the module, packs it with your key, puts it in your Studio and starts Studio
  routster-module validate <project-or-module-folder>
      checks the manifest, its four languages, its icon and its assembly
  routster-module dev-key
      makes this machine's developer key and turns developer mode on in its Studio
  routster-module pack-dev <module-folder> <out.rsmod>
      packs a built module with your key, for your own Studio
